HRA Analysis: FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (4) proved too good for a similar field last time out after starting off a 40m handicap in the early stages of the race. He meets a similar field on equal terms this time from the mobile and is likely to be very hard to beat in this race. ICONIC IMAGE (3) has good early speed and can settle in a prominent position from a good draw in this race. He was able to find the front last time out and scored a dominant win there leading all the way. He can settle close and run well again. DESIRING DIAMONDS (1) made a break last time out after settling in a good position behind the leader in the run. She has gate speed and should settle in a prominent position again in this race and shouldn’t be too far away. DINGANE (5) secured a good run before being checked and was still able to run into second behind ICONIC IMAGE (3). He draws awkwardly in this race and may be shuffled back to last in the small field. SELECTIONS: FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (4), ICONIC IMAGE (3), DESIRING DIAMONDS (1), DINGANE (5) SUGGESTED BET: FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (4) to win.

MACKEL SONNY (7) got back in the run last time out after starting from a big handicap and was finishing the race off nicely there into third. He may be shuffled back again and should be running on strongly. FENOMENAL (3) got back in the run last time out and finished the race off fairly there into sixth. He should settle closer this time and can be running on well late in this race. GETOVERROVER (4) secured a good run behind the speed before being dragged out of the race by a tiring runner. He should settle close again this time and with a bit more luck in running can be running into it late. GAZ MAN (2) was able to find the front last time out from the stand and was just fading late into fourth there. He should be able to settle close to the speed in this race and should be thereabouts. SELECTIONS: MACKEL SONNY (7), FENOMENAL (3), GETOVERROVER (4), GAZ MAN (2) SUGGESTED BET: MACKEL SONNY (7) to win.

INSTANT DELIGHT (2) looks well placed from a favourable handicap in this race. She started off the front two starts ago and wasn’t beaten far there behind Leaf Stride who she is now 10m further in front of at the start. PIZZA PRINCE (4) returns from a spell in this race and looks well handicapped. If he can step safely at the start and find a prominent position he could give them something to catch in this race. LEAF STRIDE (8) got back in the run two starts ago and was able to finish best to beat Sheetweb Weaver. He then secured a good run last time out and just couldn’t finish it off there in a race the winner rated good time. WHIRLWIND WILBUR (6) was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well there for fifth. He should settle close enough and can run well. SELECTIONS: INSTANT DELIGHT (2), PIZZA PRINCE (4), LEAF STRIDE (8), WHIRLWIND WILBUR (6) SUGGESTED BET: INSTANT DELIGHT (2) to win.

SPEAK THE TRUTH (7) is a standout on class in this race having won close to $900,000 in his career and contested a number of big races. He looks quite well suited off just a 20m handicap in this race. He won a recent trial at this track and is usually much better off his trial coming to the races. HOT AND TREACHEROUS (5) ran a good race last time out for third behind Mostert and For Real Life at this track after sitting without cover there. He has the handicap advantage on his main rival SPEAK THE TRUTH (7) and can look to hold that advantage in the early stages of the race. WHOS DELIGHT (6) ran on well into fourth last time out behind stablemate Magic Miki. He is likely to get a good run if he can step safely in this race and can be running on late again. COSMIC FLYER (4) was an upset winner last time out when getting back in the run before finishing strongly late to win on Saturday. He should settle in a prominent position in this race and is reasonably well handicapped. SELECTIONS: SPEAK THE TRUTH (7), HOT AND TREACHEROUS (5), WHOS DELIGHT (6), COSMIC FLYER (4) SUGGESTED BET: SPEAK THE TRUTH (7) to win.

RESERVED FOR ME (2) raced behind the leader last time out and battled on well not beaten too far by Bling Your A Game who seems to have good ability. She draws best of the main chances in this race and if she could find a bit more gate speed she would likely be hard to beat. ONE WICKED DAY (5) wasn’t beaten too far recently in a trial which was taken out by Jakob. She draws a touch awkwardly but should secure a good run and can be running on late. AARDIES A MOVER (3) trialled up moderately beaten 47m behind first up winner Shards Eclipse. He does still seem to be learning and may have derived good benefit from his recent trial. RACE ON BY (4) is the half sibling of smart mare Reds Ablaze. She trialled up just fairly recently but is likely to have derived good benefit from the outing. SELECTIONS: RESERVED FOR ME (2), ONE WICKED DAY (5), AARDIES A MOVER (3), RACE ON BY (4) SUGGESTED BET: RESERVED FOR ME (2) to win.

RUBY RULES (6) looks the class runner in this field. She draws wide but is a horse capable of doing work and still fighting out the finish. She sat outside the leader last time out and battled on fairly there in a race which became a dash home. REDS ABLAZE (3) may be able to press forward and find the lead early before having options from there. She trialled up well finishing third behind Scar Struck and is likely to have derived plenty of benefit from the outing. RACE FOR RICHES (4) got a long way back last time out and was able to finish strongly there to score beating Scruffy. He should get a good run off the speed again in this race and can be running on late. ULTIMATE ARK (1) should be able to drive through early and hold a prominent position in this race. He took on a weaker race last time out and didn’t have much luck when making a wide run into it. SELECTIONS: RUBY RULES (6), REDS ABLAZE (3), RACE FOR RICHES (4), ULTIMATE ARK (1) SUGGESTED BET: RUBY RULES (6) to win.

ALSROKSTAR (2) has plenty of gate speed and should be able to find the front before having options from there. He was able to find the leaders back last time out and ran well there for third behind Vodka En Ice. He can run well again from a favourable draw. POCKET BOOK (3) sat without cover two starts ago and battled on nicely there for second behind Jay Tee Tyron. She should settle close in the run in this race and can be running on late. PARTY CHANGER (5) has good gate speed and may be able to work forward and find a prominent position in this race. If he was able to find the lead he would likely take some running down and can look to repeat his effort three runs ago when leading all the way at this track. PINKCHAMPAGNE (9) went down narrowly last time out when leading and just being nabbed on the line by Smirks Lika Boss. She seems best suited when leading in her races but can still run well in this race from a soft draw. SELECTIONS: ALSROKSTAR (2), POCKET BOOK (3), PARTY CHANGER (5), PINKCHAMPAGNE (9) SUGGESTED BET: ALSROKSTAR (2) to win.

LAST HAND (2) should be able to drive through and can look to press for the lead early. He had a tough run last time out doing plenty of work and fading late. He can be an improver if he can lead and steps back to the 1660. LULU LUCIFER (1) has good gate speed and can lead before having options from there. She was running on well late last time out into fourth behind Kingsbury at Marburg. MY ULTIMATE MARIO (4) has been good in recent outings and worked hard early last time out before handing over the lead and running third behind Bettor Cheer. He should get a good run off the speed this time and can be running on late. POWERMOVE (7) was an impressive winner recently over the 2138 when doing plenty of work before sprinting past Longshot late. She did things wrong last time out and finds herself ODM as a result which makes things tougher for her. SELECTIONS: LAST HAND (2), LULU LUCIFER (1), MY ULTIMATE MARIO (4), POWERMOVE (7) SUGGESTED BET:

SWEET ROCKY (6) has good gate speed and should be able to find a prominent position in this race despite the wide draw. He ran well last time out after securing a good run close to the speed at Marburg when able to run second behind Fitzroy. MISTER REACTOR (1) hasn’t led in a long time from the mobile but appears to find a suitable race where he may be able to drive through and lead in this race. He didn’t have much luck last time out at Marburg when shuffled back and was forced to make a wide run into it. KING BOBBIE (8) should get a good run through in this race behind a horse with gate speed. He took on a strong race last time out and just did too much work there before fading out of it late. He can bounce back from a softer draw. APOLLO DREAMZ (3) ran well two starts ago finishing close up behind Protagonist in a race which became a dash home. He should settle close from a favourable draw and can run well again. SELECTIONS: SWEET ROCKY (6),MISTER REACTOR (1), KING BOBBIE (8), APOLLO DREAMZ (3) SUGGESTED BET: SWEET ROCKY (6) to win. OVERVIEW:PATNWILL (3) is racing well and has great gate speed, so he should be able to map well here. He led and won well last start at Echuca. An eye-catching horse in that same race was JAKEE BOY (6). He sustained a strong three-wide run and hit the line nicely for second. He has the best sectional times in this race, but he can get it wrong with his manners and has a sticky barrier here. MI BOW (4) hasn’t had much luck recently. Two starts ago, she looked to be getting home well but had no clear running. Last start, she just got too far back and didn’t run home as well. At her best, and with some luck, she’s an each-way play here. ROBERT JOHN (7) will need to overcome barrier seven, but he is racing well. His run two starts ago was especially impressive, flashing home well for second. With the right run, he has the ability to win and should be nearer to peak fitness here. CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (1) should get a good trip from barrier one and rarely runs a bad race. SELECTIONS: PATNWILL (3), JAKEE BOY (6), MI BOW (4), ROBERT JOHN (7)

OVERVIEW:COGNAC COWBOY (10) has the best sectional times in this event on exposed form. His two runs back this preparation have been good. Two runs back, he sustained a strong, long run from well back for second, and last start he used the sprint lane and was narrowly beaten for second. He will need some luck from the barrier. LIGHTNING ORO (5) is a first starter for up-and-coming trainer Lochie Cook. We will learn more about the horse here, but he was a nice second in a recent Terang trial. BETTORS IDEAL (8) won that same Terang trial and looks to be a quality first starter for Gary and Darryl Lawlor. He’s a half-brother to one of the fastest mares in the state, Sweet Ideal. It will be a big ask to navigate an inexperienced horse to victory from barrier eight at Ballarat, where there is no sprint lane. However, on breeding and trial form, he has the capability. SIR KITT (3) has flashed home well to place in his last two starts behind classy getaway leaders. He looks well placed here. CRYPTO CROOK (7) is an interesting runner. He sprinted home impressively for second on debut but got it wrong with his manners last start. He is having his third start here and clearly has ability. SELECTIONS: COGNAC COWBOY (10), LIGHTNING ORO (5), BETTORS IDEAL (8), SIR KITT (3)

OVERVIEW: This is a race where we have to take a lot of these horses on trust, as they can get it wrong with their manners. ITALIAN THUNDER (4) is a well-bred gelding who is first-up here for new trainer Colin Holloway. He has got it wrong with his manners in his three career starts, but he has shown glimpses of nice ability, including in his trials before he started racing. He needs to trot here. BIRMINGHAM GIRL (3) has had three career starts. She has sprinted home impressively late in two of her runs. In the other, she didn’t want a bar of trotting. She has ability and is looking to give Jodie Justice her first career win. GATESYS DELIGHT (2) has had two career starts. She finished third on debut but didn’t look safe in her trotting action. She looked better last start at Shepparton when second after a fence trip. Likely to improve again. BREDBY BRUCE (1) is a first starter with a good barrier and okay trial form. SELECTIONS: ITALIAN THUNDER (4), BIRMINGHAM GIRL (3), GATESYS DELIGHT (2), BREDBY BRUCE (1)

OVERVIEW:RIDDLEMETHIS (3) is in great form and hasn’t missed a place in his four starts this preparation. He is a great swooper and, if he is close enough, he will be the one to watch late. ONYX (8) has the best sectional times in this event and is the only horse on the back row, so has the option to get off the fence. Looking to give Chelsie O'Driscoll her first training win. NORMANDY NUGGET (1) has been racing super and has great gate speed. He should be able to capitalise on the ace barrier. HOME AND DRY (2) is racing a bit better than his numerical form suggests. He is a nice horse but will rely on luck. BACK: RIDDLEMETHIS (3)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: RIDDLEMETHIS (3), ONYX (8), NORMANDY NUGGET (1), HOME AND DRY (2)

OVERVIEW:KING KASEY (1) is in excellent form. He has good gate speed and the ace barrier to use to his advantage here. He is a smart horse who is best in front. That’s how he has won his last three starts and he will likely be the leader again here. COLOSIMO (6) is another horse in great form who has won his last two starts. He has a lot of ability and a nice turn of foot, but this barrier is sticky. GOODTIME LIBBY (5) is a fast mare. She may try to cross to the front early here with her great gate speed or wait for one run. The barrier is awkward for her, but the stable is flying. MAJOR DRAMA (3) is a mare full of confidence and in career-best form. She will need luck here, but she’s racing very well. BACK: KING KASEY (1) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: KING KASEY (1), COLOSIMO (6), GOODTIME LIBBY (5), MAJOR DRAMA (3)

OVERVIEW:STORM VENDETTA (7) is a smart, high-speed three-year-old. He has good gate speed and used that speed to find the front and lead all the way last start. He should be able to find the front here again, even from the sticky barrier. FIVE CENT (3) made up ground wide and late last start at Ararat. He has a nice turn of foot and is a versatile type, but may still need a bit of luck here. SIR NIPPA (5) is second-up here, so expecting an improved run with added fitness. He just got way too far back last start, but it wasn’t a bad run. He is returning from a preparation in Tasmania, but he was last year's Stawell Cup winner. TOPHUT JOHNY (2) is an experienced horse and a 32-time winner. He isn’t in career-best form, but if he can map well, he won't be far away. Also noting trotter NEPHEW OF SONOKO (6) is taking on the pacers here. It’s hard to line up his form, but on the clock he has the slowest recent sectional times. BACK: STORM VENDETTA (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: STORM VENDETTA (7), FIVE CENT (3), SIR NIPPA (5), TOPHUT JOHNY (2)

OVERVIEW:CLAUDYS HERO (5) has always promised to be a talented trotter. He just can get it wrong with his manners and gallops often for no reason. If he trots throughout, he is a big winning chance. He is first-up here for Alex Ashwood. THE SKY IS THE LIMIT (2) is a mare who is racing well. If she can find the fence here, she will be right in it late. DISTANT SUN (1) flashed home impressively for second two starts ago at Maryborough. Last start, she got the perfect fence trip but just didn’t let down as well late. At her best, she’s a nice chance here. DELS DESTINY (3) is a good swooper and, with the right run, will be flashing home late. He’s suited by the smaller field as he can't get too far back. SELECTIONS: CLAUDYS HERO (5), THE SKY IS THE LIMIT (2), DISTANT SUN (1), DELS DESTINY (3)

OVERVIEW: This is another event where the key contenders need to be taken with some risk due to their manners. EMMWALLEN (6) is a smart trotter, but he can gallop and do things wrong. He has the best sectional times in this event. He was outstanding last start at Kilmore, flashing home from last to finish second. If he does everything right, he’s a big chance here. KISS AT MIDNIGHT (5) is another trotter that can do things wrong. Last start, she led, took a sit and was too good late, flashing home to win well. She does have some gate speed and, if she trots throughout, she’s another key contender. YETTI (7) is very lightly raced, with only four career starts since June 2025. He has galloped in every start. Last start, when first-up, he galloped early, recovered, caught the field and let down impressively to win. Manners are key. CALABASAS (3) performed well below her best last start. A follow-up veterinary report indicated an abnormal white cell count. Connections wouldn’t be racing her unless she was back to her best health-wise. She is a nice mare with ability when she puts it all together. BACK: EMMWALLEN (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: EMMWALLEN (6), KISS AT MIDNIGHT (5), YETTI (7), CALABASAS (3)

OVERVIEW:PRETTY BASIC (2) is third-up here, so expecting him to be closer to his best. He was well back last start at Ararat but sprinted home nicely along the sprint lane for third. If he can get some luck, he’s likely to improve on that run. BLUE CANNON (3) won his last start at Shepparton. He got a perfect trip and sprinted home impressively to win. He will benefit from a bit of luck here. WINGATE GUY (5) rarely runs a bad race. He has been flashing home well each start, but he’s just been too far back. SWIM SUIT (4) can be a decent swooper in this field with some luck. SKYZ ABOVE (1) seems to perform best when she gets a fence trip at this track, which she should get here from barrier one. SELECTIONS: PRETTY BASIC (2), BLUE CANNON (3), WINGATE GUY (5), SWIM SUIT (4) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

FEEL THE MOMENT (6) finds a nice race today. She ran second behind PROHIBITED BID last start. She is racing well without winning and today looks like the day she will bounce back into the winners list. PROHIBITED BID (4) was a strong winner last start but the stand start will be a bit trickier for her today. NO REMORSE (2) and TINEY (1) are also chances.

TEN EAGLES (2) is first up from a spell today but today looks like his sort of race. If he is anywhere near his best he should be very hard to beat. LOW LIE THE FIELDS (7), EMILY MEAGAN (1) and WYLDCAT (4) are also chances.

TUFFASNAILS (7) has won his last four starts. He defeated HAPPY AS CAN BE by 6.9 metres last start. The draw will be tricky for him but he does look very hard to beat. ROCKNROLL SPIRIT (2) has won three of his last five starts and he was impressive last start when he defeated GUEST ARTIST by 5.3 metres. GUEST ARTIST (6) and ALWAYSBEALADY (4) are also big chances.

LAMBRO BAY (1) has been showing signs of improvement over his last few starts. He ran third behind FIRESIDE last start. He finds a much easier race today along with the inside draw. He should be hard to beat. VINNIES HOPE (2), GRACIOUS GODDESS (6) and MY GIRL MIA (5) are also chances.

JAWSOFGOODTIME (5) has won three of her last four starts and she is a good chance of leading today. If she can get to the lead early she should be hard to catch. PERFECT PLAYGIRL (8) was very disappointing last start but her runs before that were strong. It may pay to keep her safe. She has won two of her last four which is very strong form in a race like this. ASHANTE PRINCE (6) and WEREGOINGTOGETCHA (1) are also chances.

RESURRECTS (9) made up a lot of late ground last start where he ran second behind A MAJOR STARR. He hit the line so well and he just looks like he is aching to win a race. He is a major chance today even with the second row draw. SWEETKINDOFMAGIC (1), A MAJOR STARR (5) and DIDMESELFAMISCHIEF (4) are all big chances.

NORMY (3) is a major chance from the draw in this sort of race. He has been running around the mark recently and it may pay to look at how he ran on Saturday night as a guide. SEASIDE SHOW (4), STORMY MADEM (9) and LIGHTNING BLING (2) are also chances.

NIGHT SPIRIT (6) has won two of his last three starts and he has been rejuvenated since joining the Tony Pullicino stable. He looks like a major threat again today. OHSO KINKY (4) was an impressive winner last start at Port Pirie when she defeated WINSTON ALEXANDER by 6.3 metres. Today will be tougher but she is well drawn. WHATA OPTIMIST (9) and TWIN CONNECTION (7) are also big dangers.

SEA HUNTER (1) ran second behind MANDS PEARL last start. He is getting fitter with each run he has this preparation. He should be able to lead all of the way from the inside draw today. PARISIAN BANDIT (11), CAPTAINS DREAM (5) and ORAMA (8) are also chances.
HILLTOP STAR (5) looks extremely hard to beat in a much easier today. Her stable and driver must be given respect. CAPTAIN MOCKA (6), MY ULTIMATE BANJO (7) and CAPTAIN CAROLINE (1) are also chances.

CHASE THE STARS (2) has stand start experience and he is very well drawn today. He is a good chance of leading if he can step away cleanly. If he leads he will be very hard to catch. LOCHINVAR MAGIC (6) looks like the main danger. POWER UP (5) and WATCHMEDAZZLE (4) look the next best. WHY NOW (5) was a winner three starts at Ballarat when he defeated NIGHT FLIGHT by a head. He finds an easier race tonight and he looks the one to beat. ITGETSBETTER (3), BROWN EYED KATE (4) and ARZALI (2) are also chances.

MAJESTIC CHEDDAR (6) will provide plenty of each way value here. The draw isn’t ideal but he knows the track well and finds a very winnable race today. SPORTY ROCKS (5) looks like a big danger against this field but she was disappointing here last start. VINCENT ORILEY (1) and GLENFLYER (4) are also chances.

GUNNA ROCK (5) is first up from a spell and he hasn’t had a race start since January 2024. He showed a lot of ability during his first preparation and if he is anywhere near his best tonight then he will be hard to beat. He is risky though after how long he has been off the scene. KATUNTI (2) has race fitness on her side and she has won two of her last three starts. She is worth strong consideration today. MALINI JOH (6) and MARGARITARI (4) are also chances.

ANOTHER WOODS (5) was a last start winner at Ararat when he defeated BATTON ROUGE by a half neck. His stable and his record must be respected today. WOW YOU CAN DANCE (6) has been knocking on the door for another win and looks like a main danger. EASTBRO KAZ (3) and IMAGINATION ORO (4) are also chances.

SMOKIN STREPO (4) has stepped it up another level recently and he has won three of his last five starts. He defeated NORMANDY NUGGET by 2.1 meters at Ararat last start. He will be hard to beat again today. AMERICAN SQUARED (2) looks like the main danger. THE IRISHMAN (3) and LIVERMERE (1) are also chances.

SPOOK CROCKER (6) ran a nice race at Melton on Saturday night and he returns to a track today where he is undefeated. It’s hard to see him getting beaten despite the draw. OCEAN AVENUE (5) looks like a big danger. YANKEE MOJOH (3) and EASTBRO KOZZY (8) are also chances. OVERVIEW: It is a good race to commence the program with several winning chances. GLORIFIED (2) was resuming since an unplaced effort in the Nutrien Classic when he completely dominated his rivals to win by over twenty metres at Maryborough. He made an error and lost his chance in the Victoria Derby last time out but should go close if he delivers a fool proof display under these conditions. KEAYANG MINNESOTA (7) has won five of her ten starts for the season and is looking for four victories in succession. She beat an easier field last outing but she did commence from the handicap of 30m so she should appreciate the mobile start in this event. SAMMY HALLER (6) has been freshened since finishing unplaced in the Super Series Final. He has been taking on good fields recently and gets his chance to improve on his numerical form. BULLAPARK BENO (3) is resuming from a spell but he is nicely drawn and has the ability to show up if he is somewhere near his peak form. SELECTIONS: GLORIFIED (2), KEAYANG MINNESOTA (7), SAMMY HALLER (6), BULLAPARK BENO (3)

OVERVIEW:BRAVE ART (5) is racing in great form having been placed in four of her past five starts and deserves to break through for a win. She ran through a sensational first quarter of 26.5 seconds when a brave third at Ballarat then was left stranded on the outside of the leader at her latest second. OUTBACK QUEENIE (6) hasn’t been at her best form for some time but her latest third was encouraging and she is dropping back into a very suitable class with the aid of a concession claim so she must be respected. TAP TO PAY (4) is resuming since March and has only had one start for the season so she lacks recent racing but she did perform well enough at her latest trial third behind the classy 3yo pacer Luvtobeuptome to warrant respect. QUEENHIGH FLUSH (1) performs best when she is able to trail the leader and use her speed at the end so she is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern. BACK: BRAVE ART (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BRAVE ART (5), OUTBACK QUEENIE (6), TAP TO PAY (4), QUEENHIGH FLUSH (1)

OVERVIEW: There are a few different form lines coming into this race, which makes it a very interesting affair. IM DOWNBYTHEBEACH (2) is much better than his form reads and will appreciate a significant drop back in class so a forward showing is expected from his good draw. A win over Go Easy On Me and a second behind the top filly Willows Girl back in April are a good indication of his ability. JANSEN (6) raced without cover throughout and went down fighting in fast time at Shepparton last week. He may end up being left in the same position again from his wide draw but he is tough enough to be in the finish. STORMS (5) created a big impression against the easier Maiden class at St Arnaud, where he found the front from a wide draw and was able to slip home in a slick last half of 56.9 seconds. He is meeting a field of more depth but cannot be left out of calculations. BUBBLE OVER (7) and MY FATAL CHARM (4), which was returning from Tasmania, both performed well at Ararat and PIASTRI (8) has been racing soundly in the Riverina. SELECTIONS: IM DOWNBYTHEBEACH (2), JANSEN (6), STORMS (5), PIASTRI (8)

OVERVIEW: HAPPY ESCAPE (10) is racing in outstanding form having had three wins and two seconds behind Keayang Minnesota (has won 3 in a row) from his past five attempts. He performs best when he is close to the speed and he might have to do some work from the poor draw but he is the form runner of the field. SAINT EYES (2) settled midfield and was held up for a run a vital stage before working home nicely for second behind Snickers Express at Maryborough last outing. He has performed soundly at his two starts back from a break and is nearing a win. MATISOFF (8) has also indicated that a victory is looming in the near future having been placed in four of his past five starts. He did all of the work in the run when beaten by a narrow margin at Ararat last week and was out three horses wide from the 700m at his previous third. SILENT REVERIE (9) performs best when she is able to lead so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but she has the ability to mix it with this field. SELECTIONS: HAPPY ESCAPE (10), SAINT EYES (2), MATISOFF (8), SILENT REVERIE (9)

OVERVIEW:SINCEILEFTYOU (3) was performing nicely at the trials prior to an unlucky debut fifth, where he was three back on the markers, ran into a dead end and looked to have plenty in reserve before breaking stride late at Ararat. He is nicely bred and strikes a suitable line up so he is worth following. CARPOPHORUS (8) came from last and ran to the line well despite finishing sixth at his Victorian debut then followed with a third at Ararat after being left without cover for the final 1700m. He is awkwardly drawn but is racing well enough to figure in the finish. SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1) led out then took cover when third behind Oliver Smudge (won again since) at Charlton. She should be fitter from that run and is drawn to adopt similar tactics so she is worth thought. OVER HERE (6) disappointed last time but is capable of better and if the reserve ALDEBARAN MIGUEL (7) gains a start, he must be considered as one of the leading chances. BACK: SINCEILEFTYOU (3) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: SINCEILEFTYOU (3), CARPOPHORUS (8), SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1), OVER HERE (6)

OVERVIEW: The interesting runner is GUNSEN ROSIE (1). She hasn’t been seen publicly since her latest eighth at Kilmore back in March so her fitness is the query but she would be very competitive at her best form. She possesses early speed and is a short course specialist so the conditions of this race are suitable. CHRISTMAS BABE (6) has had a few chances recently but she is working back into some form and is the likely early leader. She attempted to lead throughout when third at Kilmore last outing. CASTLES IN THE SKY (5) raced fiercely in the leading role and was left vulnerable at the end when a distant fifth at Maryborough last outing. She gained a nice trail when second at Maryborough prior and is worth another chance. MACHO MAORI (4) is usually competitive against this class and has claims along with TOUCHANDGO (8). SELECTIONS: GUNSEN ROSIE (1), CHRISTMAS BABE (6), CASTLES IN THE SKY (5), MACHO MAORI (4)

OVERVIEW: KYVALLEY MISTY (9) settled down in eighth position and came out four horses wide on the home turn when she produced a big finish to score at Kilmore last outing. This race is no harder and considering she has been restrained to a trailing position early at her past two attempts, being drawn on the second row is no disadvantage. NEDZA THRILLER (4) has only been successful twice in 86 attempts but he is racing really well and has the early speed to be prominent throughout. He worked to the front from the standing start then took cover behind the eventual winner Happy Escape when a close second behind that trotter at St Arnaud last week. COURAGES LAW (8) settled on the markers and gained a nice run through to trail the leader from the 500m when second at Maryborough last outing. He should receive a similar economical trip from his trailing draw and is a place chance again. MONEY TALKS (6) defeated Sonnyboy (won since) at a Kilmore victory three starts ago and should be finding the line well. SELECTIONS: KYVALLEY MISTY (9), NEDZA THRILLER (4), COURAGES LAW (8), MONEY TALKS (6)

OVERVIEW: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (5) is a smart 3yo trotter, which performed nicely throughout the Need for Speed Prince series where third in a heat then made an untimely error when unplaced in the Scotch Notch Trot. He scored untouched and was impressive in his win during the Redwood Carnival so he will take beating if he delivers another fool proof display. LIFE ON THE HILL (6) is a very quick beginner and will take catching if he can find the lead. He led throughout at a Ballarat victory two starts ago then finished third at his next attempt. BEAUTIFUL SUNRISE (2) was a runaway winner at Melton two starts ago then went down narrowly at Melton last week. This race is no harder and she looms as one of the leading chances again. WEDGE TAIL EAGLE (8) and PIESRIDINGSHOTGUN (9) are both racing well enough to feature prominently if they gain the right luck in running. BACK: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (5), LIFE ON THE HILL (6), BEAUTIFUL SUNRISE (2), PIESRIDINGSHOTGUN (9)

OVERVIEW: It is a very strong heat of the Stawell Cup to wrap up the program. LOUGLE (11) made a mid-race move to park without cover when a brave second in the Swan Hill Cup then was looming as a big winning chance but broke stride in the home straight at Melton. He ran a close second behind the South Australian Derby winner Luvtobeuptome at a Maryborough trial since and should make his presence felt. REFUSAL (1) has created a strong impression at her three starts since coming from New South Wales and is drawn to run a big race. She settled three back on the inside and angled wide in the straight when she finished off best at Melton last week. ALL BLAZING GUNS (4) began very quickly from a wide draw to find the lead and fought on well for second behind Komodo on October 31. He is a speedy type and should run his usual honest race. BANDIT EYES (9) can race fiercely and tends to perform best when he is able to lead but he did come from off the pace to win at Mildura last outing and is worth thought. TO THE NINES (7) continues to race in good form and PLATINUM JIVE (8) is a value hope from her trailing draw. BACK: LOUGLE (11) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: LOUGLE (11), REFUSAL (1), ALL BLAZING GUNS (4), BANDIT EYES (9)

SAMMYS SECRET (4) was forced to race without cover last time out in a stronger race taken out by Azzif at this track in good time. He is likely to look to press forward again in this race and if he was able to find the front he would likely be very hard to run down. OYSTER STRIDE (7) draws a touch awkwardly inside the back row in this race but does look very well graded and with luck in running appears quite hard to beat. He was well beaten last time out behind Ashlee Nitro and Charlie Chuckles but should find this a lot easier. GALVARINO (6) draws awkwardly outside the front row in this race and will likely need a few things to go his way in the run. He secured a good run behind the leader last time out and was able to run second in good time behind Jimmy Bling. KEEPING IT SIMPLE (9) trialled up very nicely recently behind Havtimemajor beaten just 10 metres when finishing third. She looks set to get a good run off the speed and should be running on well late. SELECTIONS: SAMMYS SECRET (4), OYSTER STRIDE (7), GALVARINO (6), KEEPING IT SIMPLE (9) SUGGESTED BET: KEEPING IT SIMPLE (9) each way.

MAYWYNS KAREN (10) drew poorly last time out and was given a quiet run there finishing ninth. She looks very well suited in this race and can be put into the race at some stage and should be hard to beat. KEAYANG TARA (8) ran on well last time out into fourth behind Vodka En Ice in what was a stronger field with a bit more depth. She should secure a similar run off the speed in this race and can be running on late again. DOOLITTLE DOOZZIE (7) should get a good run through in this race behind the speed from a soft trailing draw. She secured a good run behind the speed last time out and was running on well late into second behind No Family Likemine. BEAU STEELE (6) draws poorly outside the front row in this race but has been racing well for a race of this nature. He was a winner four starts ago after sitting close to the speed and running over the top late. SELECTIONS: MAYWYNS KAREN (10), KEAYANG TARA (8), DOOLITTLE DOOZZIE (7), BEAU STEELE (6) SUGGESTED BET: MAYWYNS KAREN (10) to win.

DARK AND HANDSOME (6) was able to secure a good run off the speed last time out and was running on strongly there into second behind Iam Hugo. He is likely to be shuffled back again from a wide draw and can be running on well again in what appears to be a weaker race. ALLSHECANBE (1) has good gate speed and can look to drive through and lead early in this race. She was able to lead two starts ago and took them all the way scoring a comfortable win. JUNIOR RYAN (8) ran a much better race last time out securing a good run behind the leader and finishing close up in third behind Deal It Vinnie. He should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. FLUTTERING ANGEL (5) had no luck at all on return last time out when being badly checked and making a break at Marburg. She may be shuffled back from the wide draw and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: DARK AND HANDSOME (6), ALLSHECANBE (1), JUNIOR RYAN (8), FLUTTERING ANGEL (5) SUGGESTED BET: DARK AND HANDSOME (6) to win.

LITTLE WHIPPET (7) was seemingly a touch below his best last time out when sitting close to the speed and fading late into sixth. He has since trialled well for a race of this nature when beaten 51m behind Final Deadline and with luck should be hard to hold out. MULLUM BOY (2) should have the speed to press forward and find the lead in the early stages of this race from a good draw. He should find this a lot easier than his first up outing when beaten a long way by Azzif and is also likely to be better for the run. SAYCHELLES (6) draws awkwardly outside the front row in this race and will likely need a few things to go her way in the run. She got back last time out and couldn’t get into the race taken out by No Family Likemine. THREE CHORD RIFF (9) should be suited getting a good run off the speed in this race from a soft trailing draw. If the race is run to suit she should be running on strongly. SELECTIONS: LITTLE WHIPPET (7), MULLUM BOY (2), SAYCHELLES (6), THREE CHORD RIFF (9) SUGGESTED BET: MULLUM BOY (2) to win.

ASHANTE QUEEN (1) has some early speed and may look to drive through and hold a prominent position in the early stages of this race. She was able to secure a good run last time out and battled on well there for fourth at this track. FOXFIRE EASTON (7) should get a good run through in this race to sit close enough to the speed. He didn’t have the best of luck last time out at Marburg when being held up behind a tiring runner. DUAL CAM (6) draws wide in this race and may be forced to do some work at some stage of the race. He secured a good run last time out and battled on well there for second behind Martin Magic at Marburg. GREAT WHITE (2) draws well in this race and should settle close to the speed from the good draw. He got back and couldn’t get into it last time out in a race taken out by Cedar Creek Falls but is likely to have taken benefit from the run. SELECTIONS: ASHANTE QUEEN (1), FOXFIRE EASTON (7), DUAL CAM (6), GREAT WHITE (2) SUGGESTED BET: FOXFIRE EASTON (7) to win.

MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (3) should have the gate speed to find a prominent position from a good draw. He burned to the lead last time out and was just run down late by Cool Dude Joey at this track. MOVE HEAVENNEARTH (1) doesn’t have much gate speed which could prove to be an issue from the usually ideal draw. She ran well last time out in a race taken out by Bettor Cheer finishing fifth. MY PURPLE PATCH (2) drew awkwardly last time out and was shuffled back before making up good ground late into sixth. He should settle a bit closer this time from a good draw and looks one of the hardest to beat. JACCKA COOPER (6) has been very good in recent outings and was able to score a nice win two back leading all the way in good time. He backed that up by hitting the line strongly last time out into third. He should be running on strongly again. SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (3), MOVE HEAVENNEARTH (1), MY PURPLE PATCH (2), JACCKA COOPER (6) SUGGESTED BET: MOVE HEAVENNEARTH (1) to win.

AIRFORCE ONE (8) got back in the run in a slowly run race and was running into sixth late. He should get a good run off the speed again and in a more truly run race he should be hard to hold out. STRAWBERRIESNCREAM (6) draws poorly in this race outside the front row. She didn’t have much luck last time out when badly checked and taken out of play there. She can look to bounce back. POLICE PROSECUTOR (9) trialled up well enough when finishing last in a trial taken out by Big Reputation who has since come out and run well. He should get a good run off the speed and can be running on late. THE SWANSONG (1) ran well last time out when running up behind them late not having the clearest passage up the home straight into fifth. She draws favourably and should settle close enough. SELECTIONS: AIRFORCE ONE (8), STRAWBERRIESNCREAM (6), POLICE PROSECUTOR (9), THE SWANSONG (1) SUGGESTED BET: AIRFORCE ONE (8) to win. OVERVIEW:BETTORLEFTALONE (6) has gone down as an odds-on favourite in his past two runs, but he didn't race poorly. Rather, he simply found one better on both occasions. This looks to be the most suitable grade he's seen in some time, and from this draw, he can show his customary speed and strength, look to find the top and potentially run a time the others can't match. MOMENTUM SHIFT (3) may represent some value in this type of race and gets a positive barrier draw to map well. He's often had little luck, but he's a must for multiples to put some juice into them. MISTER JIMARINGLE (2) is a quick beginner and was a winner two runs back in easier grade when he sat parked and proved too strong. Herbertson seems to get the best out of him. IM DUSTEE (5) is a model of consistency, not missing the podium in his past four starts. The draw is a little sticky, but he warrants consideration. There are a few others who have claims but will need things to work out, including LOU WILL (4), MASON JOLIE (10) and NEW YORKER (11). BACK: BETTORLEFTALONE (6) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:BETTORLEFTALONE (6), MOMENTUM SHIFT (3), MISTER JIMARINGLE (2), IM DUSTEE (5)

OVERVIEW:OWEN THE SAINTS (3) looks well suited here, dropping back in grade and well drawn to map positively over the short trip at a track where he has a good strike rate. His last four starts have been against much better-quality opposition, where he's acquitted himself well. He can afford to be assertive against these and prove hard to beat. KEAYANG SANTIAGO (6) is a quick beginner and will be hustling for the top here over the mile. He tends to overdo things and knock up late, but with a positive map, he has claims. OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (1) is a veteran who may not have great numerical form, but he'll appreciate this set-up from the inside draw. The shorter trips are where he runs best, and he's a great value play for the exotics. ATOMIK GO ANNA (8) is a 2yo filly who gives away experience here, but she does have ability. The issue is that she can't draw a barrier at the moment, although she's going okay. MAJOR ORION (10) was disappointing last time but was a winner prior after a succession of solid performances, so keep him safe despite the draw. LEONARD (7) can show good speed but will need plenty to go right to secure a decent map. BACK: OWEN THE SAINTS (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:OWEN THE SAINTS (3), KEAYANG SANTIAGO (6), OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (1), ATOMIK GO ANNA (8)

OVERVIEW:WHERES WOOD WOOD (6) has made a habit this season of winning when she drops back to this grade, but overall, she's never raced better than she has this year. She's a versatile type who can show speed or come with one run, so despite the sticky draw, she has options. Tasmyn Potter also has an excellent record on her. MISS PIGGY WIGGY (3) was unlucky not to win here last week. She went back to last from a wide draw, sliced through the field late and was held up at a crucial stage before narrowly missing victory. She's hard to catch with her gate manners, but if she decides to go forward and lead, she'll take some catching. MAURLEN GRACE (1) was much better last week and now gets a soft draw, so with added fitness and a top driver, she looks a natural improver. JUST MY LUCK (9) finally broke through for his maiden last start and looks to be putting it all together recently, so if he continues that trajectory, he's in the mix again. KRAKEY (5) was able to lead from a similar draw last week and was sound in running 3rd. He's always thereabouts, so keep him safe. CAPTAINS RUSH (2) also has the benefit of a run under her belt and has claims from the soft draw in this type of line-up. SELECTIONS:WHERES WOOD WOOD (6), MISS PIGGY WIGGY (3), MAURLEN GRACE (1), JUST MY LUCK (9)

OVERVIEW:ELIANA (8) looked to get every chance here last week from the pole over the short trip, but to be fair, they did run decent time for this grade. I'm willing to give her another shot, given she trails behind the main danger, who will be stamped urgent early, and should get the cover she needs to strike late. ALTO CORAGGIO (1) has been tipped on top nearly every start I've found him, and he's been runner-up on each occasion. He's a flashy-looking type who presents as a decent prospect, so perhaps with more maturity, he can put it all together. He has gate speed and looks to get the right map. MADAM SASS (2) is a 2yo filly who went for a run up in NSW and performed fairly when she was able to lead from the pole. Her trials prior were okay, and although she's drawn down low, the map is a little uncertain. TOUCH OF REALITY (4) often likes to show gate speed, and there are a few drawn underneath her on this occasion, but she's ever-consistent, so must be included. SELECTIONS:ELIANA (8), ALTO CORAGGIO (1), MADAM SASS (2), TOUCH OF REALITY (4)

OVERVIEW:OUR MYSTERY BET (4) may not have the most impressive numerical form, but he drops back to the most suitable grade he's raced in for a while. He's a grinding type who'll be obliged to race forward here over the short trip, and although there are others who will be faster off the arm into position, he can wear them down late. ZEUSS (7) was a winner last time after some nice efforts for the new camp and now gets a challenging draw to overcome. However, his form is better than most, and with the right luck, he can be in the finish. THE LADYBIRD (8) got a sweet run and was too good in a winnable race last time, and although the draw is tricky, this doesn't present as much harder. MYNAMEISRUBY (3) and HIGHVIEW HAMMER (5) are the speed horses off the arm and most likely to get the right positions, but they've had plenty of chances all the same. BACK: OUR MYSTERY BET (4) – 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:OUR MYSTERY BET (4), ZEUSS (7), THE LADYBIRD (8), MYNAMEISRUBY (3)

OVERVIEW:YELLA (4) gets me in every time because he's been so well placed on his best form but just hasn't been able to crack it. The winner of his last race went very quickly and has since won again, so the form out of that race is strong. On that line, he should be given another chance to atone. He cap map well from this favourable draw and get every chance. TREACHEROUSTIMES (1) led up from the same draw last week and was disappointing, but this is slightly easier, so on his best form and likely map, he can improve on that effort. BERYLS BOOTS (9) hasn't had much go his way in his past couple, but his form prior was solid. He has a back-row draw to contend with again, but he's in the mix. JOEYS HANGOVER (5) and SALSBOY (6) were in the same race last start and not far away from one another, but the draws are a little different now, while STELLAR QUEEN (8) gets a soft draw and has minor claims. BACK: YELLA (4) – 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:YELLA (4), TREACHEROUSTIMES (1), BERYLS BOOTS (9), JOEYS HANGOVER (5)

OVERVIEW:ALDEBARAN DENBAY (7) has been terrific for trainer Brooke McPherson, racing tractably and consistently and delivering strong performances at this level and track. The wide draw is no luxury, but even if the lead isn't there, he sat parked last week and ran well. Tasmyn Potter's claim helps him get in front of a few key rivals, and she had a good feel for him last start. SETTLE THE BILL (9) is an interesting runner. She was a beauty here last season, winning plenty of races, but then seemed to lose her way a little when she went up in grade and changed stables. Now she's back with Laura Wilson, and if the trial margin is any indication, she could be primed for a return to form. STRAIGHT TO THETOP (8) was in a good position before trotting poorly over the last 400m, but she's better than that and can bounce back from the soft draw. STARLIGHT RED (1), GIGGLE WATER (3) and ATTRACTED (4) all have place claims from their favourable draws. BACK: ALDEBARAN DENBAY (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ALDEBARAN DENBAY (7), SETTLE THE BILL (9), STRAIGHT TO THETOP (8), GIGGLE WATER (3)

OVERVIEW:MASTER MIKI (4) doesn't have the best numerical form, but his best has seen him become a three-time winner at this track. His win here in September was from a wider draw and showed he can run times that others have to lift to match. Riley Pace is an in-form young driver, which is a major asset in these concession races. ASHANTE WARRIOR (2) has had four runs now for the astute Ashwood stable and was good winning his maiden first up for them. He hasn't been far away since in what looked to be tougher company than he meets here. He can show gate speed and get the right run, and against this class, he can bounce back into the winner's circle. ARMOURY (5) is the stablemate, a 3yo filly who's had only one run for the camp and led before fading at Mildura. She'll need to improve on that but is capable of doing so with more time in her new surroundings. COLBY ART (1) was a good winner in an easier race here last week, making the most of a soft draw and running good enough time to be in the finish here. SELECTIONS:MASTER MIKI (4), ASHANTE WARRIOR (2), ARMOURY (5), COLBY ART (1)

OVERVIEW:SHINELIKETHESUN (3) has won only one race from 19 starts, but you could make a case that she should have been in the winner's circle a lot more often if she trotted more consistently. That was the situation at Melton last week, where she would have gone close to scoring if she'd trotted the whole way. Take her on trust, as her best is good enough. CLASSIC FAIR (9) got it all wrong as favourite last time at Echuca, galloping at the start and in running, yet still hanging in there for 4th. He won on debut and wasn't too bad two runs back, so there's ability there to keep him safe. ALDEBARAN MISTIQUE (4) started favourite last time out and didn't have a lot of luck before jumping it off. She was doing okay prior to that. MOONSHINE LOUIE (2) has run some decent races against a couple of smart ones and looks reliably gaited of late, which is an asset in a race of this type. ALABAMA MAY (6) has shown ability at times and has been freshened up for this with no trial, so she may need the run, but don't dismiss her. THE WRECKING BALL (1) is a first starter who's trialled okay, so is worth monitoring for any betting moves. SELECTIONS:SHINELIKETHESUN (3), CLASSIC FAIR (9), ALDEBARAN MISTIQUE (4), MOONSHINE LOUIE (2)
